text.tspan: Contacts: 10 A 250 V AC / 30 V DC (relay rating). Potential-free (dry) contact.
1. R17/R19 hold the MOSFET off while the ESP32 boots, so the door can never open during reset or power-up.
2. Strike / bolt (fail-secure): PSU+ -> COM, NO -> lock+. Maglock (fail-safe): PSU+ -> COM, NC -> maglock+.
Gate / garage / sliding-door operator: COM + NO across its "push-button / open" input (0.5-1 s pulse).
3. Fit a flyback diode across DC lock coils (or a varistor across AC loads) at the lock.
4. If the relay ever switches 230 V, keep >= 6 mm creepage + a PCB slot between contacts and low-voltage circuits.
5. Channel 2 (K2, Q2, R18, R19, D7, J6) is optional: second door, roller shutter up/down, siren.
